title: BUILT CoLAB 2024 Christmas lunch
excerpt: On 19 December, BUILT CoLAB brought the whole team together for the 2024 Christmas Lunch! This was the last moment of socialising and taking stock of the year, already thinking about the objectives for 2025, always with the promotion of the Twin-Transition of the AEC Sector in mind.
content:
On 19 December, BUILT CoLAB brought the whole team together for the 2024 Christmas Lunch!

This was the last moment of socialising and taking stock of the year, already thinking about the objectives for 2025, always with the promotion of the Twin-Transition of the AEC Sector in mind.
